# cubepath Provider

Interact with CubePath Cloud API to manage infrastructure resources.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) API token for CubePath Cloud. Can also be set via CUBE_API_TOKEN environment variable.
- `baremetal_deploy_timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds for baremetal deployment operations. Defaults to 1800 (30 minutes).
- `base_url` (String) Base URL for the CubePath API. Defaults to https://api.cubepath.com. Can also be set via CUBE_API_URL environment variable.
- `default_timeout` (Number) Default timeout in seconds for API operations. Defaults to 300 (5 minutes).
- `max_retries` (Number) Maximum number of retries for failed API requests. Defaults to 3.
- `retry_wait_max` (Number) Maximum wait time in seconds between retries. Defaults to 30.
- `retry_wait_min` (Number) Minimum wait time in seconds between retries. Defaults to 1.
- `vps_create_timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds for VPS creation operations. Defaults to 600 (10 minutes).
- `vps_destroy_timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds for VPS destruction operations. Defaults to 300 (5 minutes).
